hooks.command: bash -c '[ -z "$CONDUCTOR_ID" ] && exit 0; cmux-team send SESSION_STARTED --conductor-id "$CONDUCTOR_ID" --surface "${CMUX_SURFACE:-unknown}" --pid "$PPID" --session-id "${SESSION_ID:-}" 2>/dev/null || true'
bash -c '[ -z "$CONDUCTOR_ID" ] && exit 0; cmux-team send SESSION_ENDED --conductor-id "$CONDUCTOR_ID" --surface "${CMUX_SURFACE:-unknown}" --pid "$PPID" --reason "stop" 2>/dev/null || true'

python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); p=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); (print('.team/tasks/ への直接書き込みは禁止です。cmux-team create-task / cmux-team update-task CLI を使用してください。', file=sys.stderr) or sys.exit(2)) if '.team/tasks/' in p else sys.exit(0)"
